description: A right-click / long-press context menu built on the native HTML Popover API — the same bordered, shadow-defined panel of selectable rows (plain items, checkbox/radio items, submenus) as Dropdown, positioned at the pointer instead of anchored to a trigger. Keyboard, typeahead, and focus are owned by the headless primitive.

props.name: children
props.description:
The {@link ContextMenu.Trigger } and {@link ContextMenu.Content } pair
(Root renders no wrapping element of its own).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the menu is open on first render.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `open` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction for the menu. Affects which arrow key opens / closes
a submenu — `ArrowRight` opens in `"ltr"`, `ArrowLeft` opens in
`"rtl"`. Falls back to the inherited {@link DirectionProvider } value,
or to `"ltr"` if no provider is present.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Observes open-state transitions. Fires only on user-driven changes
(right-click, Escape, selection, outside click), never on external
flips. Optional in uncontrolled mode.
Called with the requested open state on each user-driven transition.
Required in controlled mode.

props.name: open
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultOpen` instead.
Whether the menu is open. Must be kept in sync by the parent via
`onOpenChange`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the child element instead of the default `<span>`, merging the
trigger's `contextmenu` handler and data-attributes onto it via the
{@link Slot } pattern. The child must accept a `ref`.

props.name: children
props.description: The content the right-click gesture is bound to.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
When `true`, the trigger ignores the `contextmenu` gesture entirely,
letting the native browser menu through. Exposed as `data-disabled=""`.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLSpanElement` (or the `asChild` host).

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Panel + row scale; `data-density` scales the sizing within each size. Re-points every child sizing knob (item height/padding/gap/radius/font, panel radius/padding, label, separator) — the same size scale as Dropdown.

contractProps.name: placement
contractProps.description: SubContent only — the root Content is always positioned at the pointer (no placement prop) via the headless layer's `left` / `top`, with `@position-try` fallbacks flipping it on viewport overflow. A submenu, like Dropdown's, is anchor-positioned to its SubTrigger via CSS anchor positioning and opens to the inline-end side by default.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the child element instead of the default `<li role="menuitem">`,
merging the item's props onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern (e.g. to
render a menu item as an `<a>`).

props.name: children
props.description: The item's visible content.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Removes the item from activation and marks it `aria-disabled`; it
still renders for assistive technology but no-ops on click / Enter, and
arrow navigation and typeahead skip it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Fires when the item is activated (click, Enter, or Space). Called
with an event whose `preventDefault()` skips the auto-close that

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is open. Reflected: it changes as the user opens and dismisses it. Set it (or the `open` property) to open or close it from script, where it opens at its last position.

events.name: primitiv-context-menu-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied — a right-click, Escape, a press outside or a chosen item — with the open state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

events.name: primitiv-context-menu-select
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired on the item part when an item is chosen, after a checkbox or radio item has changed. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the menu open.

events.name: primitiv-context-menu-checked-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired on a checkbox item before it changes, with its state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

events.name: primitiv-context-menu-value-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired on a radio group before its value changes, with the value afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the submenu is open. Reflected.

events.name: primitiv-context-menu-sub-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied, with the open state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: A right-click here opens nothing, and the browser's own menu shows.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Skipped by the keyboard, and does nothing when clicked (`aria-disabled` on the child).

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether it is checked; `checked="indeterminate"` for mixed. Reflected.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value it sets on its group.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep it shown while unchecked, to animate it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: It does not open the submenu.
